attchmntText: Themis Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Themis Medicare Limited submitted an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, net revenue grew 15.1% year-on-year to Rs. 89.74 crore. The company reported a return to operating profitability with EBITDA of Rs. 5.58 crore at a 6.2% margin. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 7.06 crore, compared to a loss in the year-ago quarter. API business revenue rebounded by 71% to Rs. 20 crore. For H1 FY27, total revenue was Rs. 176.70 crore. The presentation highlighted strong performance in the Critical Care and Ortho divisions. The company remains focused on operational efficiency and expanding its hospital business presence.

attchmntText: Themis Medicare Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the un-audited standalone & consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Themis Medicare Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results are accompanied by Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors M/s. Krishaan & Co., Chartered Accountants. The meeting commenced at 01.00 P.M. IST and concluded at 02.30 P.M. IST. The Chairman and Director, Dinesh S. Patel, with DIN 00033275, submitted the information for the record of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
